body.name: Hhat
body.def: Let \(\widehat H_{\mathrm{raw}}^{-\ell}(x)=N^{\prime}\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(x)N\). The foldwise rank selector is \(\widehat r^{-\ell}(x)=\#\{j:\lambda_j(\widehat H_{\mathrm{raw}}^{-\ell}(x))>\tau_n\}\), and \(\widehat H^{-\ell}(x)\) retains exactly those eigencomponents, with Moore--Penrose inverse formed from the retained eigenvalues; the zero-rank convention applies when no eigenvalue exceeds \(\tau_n\).
